title: Correct Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct lifetime of the muon as 10^-6 seconds.

title: Precision of Answer
description: Important Criteria: The student acknowledges the more precise value of tau_mu as 2.2 x 10^-6 seconds.

title: Understanding of Lifetime
description: Important Criteria: The student demonstrates an understanding of what the lifetime of a muon represents in terms of particle physics.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that the units of seconds are consistent throughout the response.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to recognize that the lifetime is not 10^2 or 10^9 seconds, which are incorrect.
